description: Comic books route of the City of Brussels is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Brussels/Urban Renewal. List of the frescos of the « Parcours BD » (comic books route) in the City of Brussels. For the past 30 years, the « Parcours BD » pays tribute to comic strips characters and authors on the walls of the City of Brussels. More info:. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Culture. Its keywords are comic strips, fresco, comic books, comic books route, street art, art. The portal shows 70 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-05-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
